notes.title: Announcing Last Card Dungeon!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]it’s me, your solo dev Carlo, dropping in with some exciting news! If you loved my other games, I’m sure you’ll want to check out my latest passion project: [b]Last Card Dungeon[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DZ8dCkUY0iA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]The story...[/h3][p align="start"]Imagine this: you lost a card game in a tavern...and your soul got trapped inside a cursed deck of cards. Now you’re stuck in a dark roguelike dungeon world where every move, every battle eats away your soul, literally your deck of cards. It’s a tough race against time, full of strategy and mystery. You build your deck, explore cursed places, fight for survival, and hunt the hooded figure who trapped you before your cards run out.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]What is it?[/h3][p align="start"]It’s pixel art, roguelike autobattler action with a haunting atmosphere:[/p][list][*][p][b]Autobattler combat:[/b] Your position, combined with your weapon, determines how you'll deal damage to the enemy slots. Choosing the right weapon is the key to survive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gear management:[/b] Equip unique and powerful items that can change your playstyle, but beware! Some cursed gear sticks with you until you find a way to remove it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploration & events:[/b] Navigate randomly generated dungeons full of intriguing events, tough choices, and unpredictable encounters that keep every run fresh and exciting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Wishlist it[/h3][p align="start"]Check it out on Steam, wishlist it if you like what you see, and follow for updates. Thanks for all the support so far, it means the world to me![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921690/Last_Card_Dungeon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"]Your friend, the solo dev Carlo.[/p]
